EventRoleView.description: One opportunity an event creates a shift for.

edited.description: Whether a person changed the count from the opportunity's default. Recorded rather than compared against the default now, because the default can change.
edited.title: Edited

needId.description: Amplify need ID the shift is created under.
needId.title: Needid

EventRoleView.title: EventRoleView

EventView.description: One calendar event, as the current revision holds it.

addedByHand.description: Whether a person pulled the event in rather than the search finding it.
addedByHand.title: Addedbyhand

blocking.description: Whether this event stops the run being sent. True when it has no opportunity to create a shift under. The run stops rather than dropping it, because a missing shift is invisible until volunteers cannot sign up.
blocking.title: Blocking

calendarEnd.description: End time on the calendar, in the run's zone.
calendarEnd.title: Calendarend

calendarStart.description: Start time on the calendar, in the run's zone.
calendarStart.title: Calendarstart

cappedAt.description: The opportunity maximum that shortened this shift, or null when nothing did. Present so a reader is told which number decided the length rather than left wondering why the shift is shorter than the event.
cappedAt.title: Cappedat

category.description: Data model category the title matched, or null when nothing matched.
category.title: Category

date.description: Day of the event, as an ISO date.
date.title: Date

duplicateOf.description: Identifier of an earlier event in this revision that would create the same shift, or null when none would. Sameness is the row Amplify receives -- need ID, date, start and end -- so two events at one hour under different opportunities are two shifts, not a repeat.
duplicateOf.title: Duplicateof

lengthMinutes.description: How long the shift lasts, which is the duration Amplify is given. Not above zero means the shift ends before it starts, which blocks the send.
lengthMinutes.title: Lengthminutes

match.description: How the category was reached, or null when the event was added by hand or matched nothing. Stored as it happened, because the data model can change between the day a run is collected and the day it is read.

roles.description: The opportunities this event creates shifts for.
roles.title: Roles

shiftEnd.description: End time of the shift to create.
shiftEnd.title: Shiftend

shiftStart.description: Start time of the shift to create, which is the calendar time plus the opportunity's offset.
shiftStart.title: Shiftstart

title.description: Event title, as the calendar gave it.
title.title: Title

EventView.title: EventView

status.description: Always "ok": a reply at all is the health report.
status.title: Status

JobView.description: A long operation, as a caller sees it.

createdAt.description: When it was asked for, as an ISO-8601 UTC time.
createdAt.title: Createdat

detail.description: Why it failed, when it did and when the reason is one a caller can act on. A failure the service did not expect says so without its reason, which is in the service log against the job.
detail.title: Detail

finishedAt.description: When it stopped, or null while it has not.
finishedAt.title: Finishedat

id.description: Identifier the job is addressed by.
id.title: Id

kind.description: What it is doing: collect, recollect, send.
kind.title: Kind

runId.description: Run the job is working on.
runId.title: Runid

startedAt.description: When it began, or null while it is queued.
startedAt.title: Startedat

status.description: Where it is: queued, running, succeeded, failed, interrupted. "interrupted" means the service stopped while it was in hand, so how far it got is unknown; resuming one is a deliberate action, never automatic.
status.title: Status

JobView.title: JobView

LogEntryView.description: One line of a run's change log.

entry.description: What changed, written for a reader.
entry.title: Entry

id.description: Identifier, ascending in the order entries were written.
id.title: Id

loggedAt.description: When the change was made, as an ISO-8601 UTC time.
loggedAt.title: Loggedat

principalId.description: Who made it. One value while the credential is a static token, and a real subject once an identity provider issues one, with no change to what records it.
principalId.title: Principalid

revision.description: Revision that was current when the change was made.
revision.title: Revision

LogEntryView.title: LogEntryView

MatchView.description: How an event's title was matched to a category.

keyword.description: The alias that matched, or null for a fuzzy match.
keyword.title: Keyword

kind.description: How it matched: "keyword" for an alias whose words all appear in the title, or "fuzzy" for the fallback.
kind.title: Kind

score.description: Fuzzy confidence from 0 to 100, or null for a keyword match, which is not scored.
score.title: Score

MatchView.title: MatchView

OpportunityView.description: An Amplify opportunity a run creates shifts under.

defaultSlots.description: Volunteers wanted per shift, before any edit.
defaultSlots.title: Defaultslots

maxLength.description: Longest shift the opportunity accepts, in minutes, or null when it sets no maximum.
maxLength.title: Maxlength

offsetEnd.description: Minutes added to an event's end to reach the shift's.
offsetEnd.title: Offsetend

offsetStart.description: Minutes added to an event's start to reach the shift's.
offsetStart.title: Offsetstart

OpportunityView.title: OpportunityView

RunCountsView.description: What the run's current revision holds.

shifts.description: Shifts a send would create. Counted per role rather than per event, because an event serving both skating and non-skating officials creates two.
shifts.title: Shifts

unmatched.description: Events that would create no shift at all, and so stop the run being sent. A title that matched nothing has no opportunity to create a shift under, and a category that resolved to no need ID leaves the same absence.
unmatched.title: Unmatched

RunCountsView.title: RunCountsView

RunDetailView.description:
A run with everything the review screen reads at once.

The events, the opportunities labelling them and the change
log arrive together because a screen showing one shows all
three, and reading them separately would let them disagree:
each read would see the state at a different moment.

activeJobId.description: Identifier of the job still working on this run, or null when nothing is. What makes a run somebody walked away from reattachable: read the job, or follow its events.
activeJobId.title: Activejobid

collectedAt.description: When it was created, as an ISO-8601 UTC time.
collectedAt.title: Collectedat

currentRevision.description: Number of the revision now being edited, or 0 before the first one exists.
currentRevision.title: Currentrevision

events.description: The current revision's events, by date and start time.
events.title: Events

id.description: Identifier the run is addressed by. Minted by the server, and never the path of a file the run produced.
id.title: Id

log.description: Every change made to the run, oldest first. Written where the change is made rather than assembled by whatever displays it, so it survives a reload and reads the same in a browser and a terminal.
log.title: Log

opportunities.description: Amplify titles for every need ID this run touches, resolved while the run was collected and stored with it. Every review row is labelled with one, so they are not a lookup deferred to preview time.
opportunities.title: Opportunities

revisedAt.description: When it last changed, as an ISO-8601 UTC time. The time it was collected, for a run nothing has changed yet.
revisedAt.title: Revisedat

sentAt.description: When its shifts reached Amplify, or null while they have not.
sentAt.title: Sentat

status.description: Where the run is: collecting, unsent, partly_sent, sent.
status.title: Status

RunDetailView.title: RunDetailView

id.description: Identifier the run is addressed by. Minted by the server, and never the path of a file the run produced.

revisedAt.title: Revisedat

sentAt.description: When its shifts reached Amplify, or null while they have not.
sentAt.title: Sentat

status.description: Where the run is: collecting, unsent, partly_sent, sent.

WindowView.description: The days a run covers, and the zone they are read in.

end.description: Day after the last day the run covers, as an ISO date. Exclusive, so a run covering one day carries two consecutive dates.
end.title: End

start.description: First day the run covers, as an ISO date.
start.title: Start

timezone.description: Zone the two dates are read in. The server's zone is the authoritative one: a client displays these dates and never works a window out in the zone of whoever is looking at it.
timezone.title: Timezone

get.description: Answers for a job whether it is queued, running or over. A caller watching one polls this, or reads the event stream for the same job to be told as it happens.

parameters.description: Identifier the job was created with.
parameters.name: job_id

schema.description: Identifier the job was created with.
schema.title: Job Id

get.summary: Report where a job has got to

get.description:
A server-sent event stream. Each frame is named for what the job reported and carries what that report held. The stream ends with a "job_finished" frame when the job is over.

It is reattachable: a client that reconnects sends the identifier of the last frame it saw in "Last-Event-ID", and is given what it missed rather than what it already has. A browser sends that header itself.

parameters.description: Identifier the job was created with.
parameters.name: job_id

schema.description: Identifier the job was created with.
schema.title: Job Id

200.description: The job's events, as they happen.

get.summary: Follow what a job reports, as it reports it

get.description: Every run the service holds, most recently collected first, including one still being collected. Each carries what its current revision holds and the job still working on it, so the list is enough to decide what to open without reading each run in turn.

schema.title: Response List Runs V1 Runs Get

get.description:
The run, the events of its current revision, the Amplify opportunities labelling them, and the log of everything done to it. Read together because a screen showing one shows all of them, and separate reads could disagree.

Each event carries what its stored row does not say: how long the shift is, the maximum that shortened it, whether an earlier event would create the same shift, and whether it blocks the send.

parameters.description: Identifier the run was created with.
parameters.name: run_id

schema.title: Run Id
